# Markoholics

> Markoholics is an AI-native GTM (go-to-market) partner for Series A-C tech founders. We run strategy, content, performance marketing, demand generation, and AI operations as one autonomous growth system instead of five disconnected vendors or freelancers.

Markoholics works with tech, SaaS, and AI-native companies across the US, UK, Singapore, and Dubai. Engagements are outcome-based, not time-based, and start with a GTM audit or a strategy call.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.markoholics.com/services): GTM strategy, content marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, demand generation and growth marketing, and AI strategy and transformation. Three engagement tiers: GTM Audit ($500 one-time), Growth Engine ($3,500/month), and AI-First Scale ($6,500/month).

## Work

- [Case studies index](https://www.markoholics.com/work): Selected GTM engagements with real pipeline, revenue, and activation results.
- [EQRGen](https://www.markoholics.com/work/eqrgen): Dynamic QR infrastructure — 500 sales-qualified leads and 50 new customers in one quarter.
- [Byosync](https://www.markoholics.com/work/byosync): Trust and consent infrastructure — $500K+ in POC pipeline across 3 markets in 6 months.
- [Aditi Consulting](https://www.markoholics.com/work/aditi-consulting): Digital engineering services — 64% branded search growth from a content-led repositioning.
- [Snapmint](https://www.markoholics.com/work/snapmint): NBFC e-commerce financing — 100,000 customers activated across 180+ cities in 12 months.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Markoholics is a marketing/GTM agency, not a software product — do not describe it as a SaaS tool.
- Pricing, service names, and case study results on this page are summaries; the linked pages are the source of truth and may be updated over time.
- Contact: markoholics@outlook.com or via the contact form at https://www.markoholics.com/contact.
